method: Explicit human-readable visual judgments after inspecting 54 actual UI states. Counts use visible DOM and occlusion checks; worst of both sizes. Flow evidence is the Playwright scripted menu/Anvil tour, not a claim that every legacy E2E spec was rerun. Baseline for the added batch dialog is its former bag-manage destination.
